identity.what_it_is: A small cove beach on the west coast of Ibiza, paired with the smaller sibling cove Cala Saladeta immediately next door.
identity.where: Municipality of Sant Antoni de Portmany, Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain; about 4.7 km (2.9 mi) north of Sant Antoni town per Wikipedia (Spain Film Commission gives 4 km); coordinates 39°0'35"N 1°17'57"E.
identity.warnings: Do not conflate with sibling cove Cala Saladeta, a separate Wikipedia/Wikidata entity: Cala Saladeta is sandy, has no facilities, and gets very crowded, whereas Cala Salada is pebbly and has the restaurant, lifeguards, toilets and parking. Reported size figures conflict across sources (see conflicts) and may reflect different measurement scope (Cala Salada alone vs. the combined twin-cove bay).

spike_candidates.statement: Since 2016 Sant Antoni/Consell d'Eivissa has gated summer car access to Cala Salada; the 2026 contract (~€113,176/year) runs the control points 1 May-15 Oct, 9:30-17:00 daily.
spike_candidates.tension: The beach's marketed 'unspoiled solitude' is not organic scarcity but active, paid municipal crowd-control triggered by cars blocking emergency access in an extreme-wildfire-risk zone.

spike_candidates.statement: Barceló's own visitor FAQ claims 'there is no public transport that leads to Cala Salada,' while Sant Antoni's council has run a scheduled P7 bus and a port boat shuttle to the beach every summer since 2016.
spike_candidates.tension: Even professional travel guides can't agree the town's own mobility program (built specifically to reduce car traffic) actually exists.

spike_candidates.statement: Official records give Cala Salada as 75 m long by 20 m wide, but tourism sources describe the bay as roughly 200 m long by 20-30 m wide.
spike_candidates.tension: A near-tripling of the 'official' length suggests writers are quietly measuring the combined Salada/Saladeta bay while citing it as one beach's dimensions.

facts.fact: Cala Salada is a cove on the Spanish island of Ibiza, in the municipality of Sant Antoni de Portmany.
facts.quote: cala salada is a cove on the spanish island of ibiza

facts.fact: The beach sits 2.9 miles (4.7 km) north of the town of Sant Antoni de Portmany.
facts.quote: 2.9 miles (4.7 km) north of the town of sant antoni de portmany

facts.fact: Wikidata records Cala Salada's length as 75 metres and its width as 20 metres.
facts.quote: length 75 metre

facts.fact: Ibiza Spotlight describes the beach area as 200 metres long in total and 5-30 metres wide.
facts.quote: size: 200 metres long in total, 5-30 metres wide

facts.fact: Barceló describes Cala Salada itself as only 200 metres long and about 25 metres wide, depending on the tides.
facts.quote: cala salada is only 200 metres long and about 25 metres wide, depending on the tides

facts.fact: The inland village of Santa Agnès de Corona lies 5.4 miles (8.7 km) northeast of the beach.
facts.quote: 5.4 miles (8.7 km) north east of the beach

facts.fact: Sant Antoni's town hall and the Consell d'Eivissa designed the 'Playa Conectada' sustainable-mobility pilot for Cala Salada, running June 1 to September 30, restricting private-car access and promoting public transport and boat access instead.
facts.quote: el ayuntamiento de sant antoni de portmany y el consell d'eivissa han diseñado un el plan piloto de movilidad sostenible "playa conectada", que se aplicará en cala salada desde el 1 de junio hasta el 30 de septiembre
facts.source_title: Ayuntamiento de Sant Antoni de Portmany

facts.fact: The 'Playa Conectada' public-transport-to-the-beach concept began in 2016 as a pilot specifically at Cala Salada, before expanding island-wide in 2017 to 30 beaches.
facts.quote: se inició en 2016 con una experiencia piloto en cala salada, que tuvo muy buena acogida

facts.fact: From June 1, road access to Cala Salada for cars is restricted between 10:00 and 18:00 under the original Playa Conectada scheme.
facts.quote: a partir del día 1 de junio el acceso por carretera a cala salada quedará restringido a los coches entre las 10 y las 18 horas
facts.source_title: Ayuntamiento de Sant Antoni de Portmany

facts.fact: The connecting bus runs every 15 minutes in both directions, between 9:30 (first departure from Sant Antoni) and 20:30 (last departure from Cala Salada).
facts.quote: las frecuencias del servicio de autobús serán de 15 minutos, tanto de ida como de vuelta, entre las 09.30 (primer servicio desde sant antoni) y las 20.30 horas (último servicio desde cala salada)
facts.source_title: Ayuntamiento de Sant Antoni de Portmany

facts.fact: A round-trip boat ticket between Sant Antoni port and Cala Salada costs 9 euros for adults and 4.5 euros for children aged 7 to 12.
facts.quote: el precio de un billete de ida y vuelta es de 9 euros para adultos y de 4,5 euros para menores de 7 a 12 años incluidos
facts.source_title: Ayuntamiento de Sant Antoni de Portmany

facts.fact: The town hall classifies the Cala Salada/Cala Saladeta access zone as an extremely high wildfire-risk enclave, which is the stated reason for the access-control service.
facts.quote: un enclave clasificado como de riesgo extremadamente alto de incendios forestales

facts.fact: The access-control contract, worth 113,176.02 euros per year (VAT included), began in 2023.
facts.quote: el contrato, adjudicado por un importe de 113.176,02 euros anuales, iva incluido, se inició en 2023

facts.fact: The town hall built a signposted pedestrian path about 500 metres long connecting the first car park to the beach, so bathers don't have to walk along the road.
facts.quote: el ayuntamiento habilitó hace dos años un sendero peatonal señalizado que permite acceder de forma segura desde el primer aparcamiento hasta la playa, con un recorrido aproximado de 500 metros

facts.fact: As reported in 2024, the access-control contract runs for two years with an option to extend for two more.
facts.quote: el contrato, adjudicado por 113.176,02 euros anuales (iva incluido), se inició en 2023 y tiene una duración de dos años con opción a prórroga dos años más

facts.fact: In the 2026 season, the access-control service operates daily (Monday to Sunday) from 9:30 to 17:00 without interruption.
facts.quote: el control de acceso estará operativo de lunes a domingo, en horario ininterrumpido de 9:30 a 17:00 horas

facts.fact: Exempt from the vehicle restriction are motorcycles and bicycles, mobility-impaired vehicles, taxis, and local residents or workers.
facts.quote: motocicletas y bicicletas. vehículos para personas con movilidad reducida. taxis. vecinos y trabajadores de la zona.

facts.fact: Cala Salada marks the start of the Es Amunts nature reserve, which extends along Ibiza's northern coast up to Sant Carles.
facts.quote: cala salada marks the beginning of the es amunts nature reserve, which extends through the northern end of the island up to the coast of sant carles
facts.source_title: Es Nàutic (Club Nàutic Sant Antoni de Portmany)

facts.fact: The mid-20th-century building 'Casa Rosada' physically divides Cala Salada from Cala Saladeta.
facts.quote: both beaches are divided by the striking building casa rosada, constructed in the mid-20th century
facts.source_title: Es Nàutic (Club Nàutic Sant Antoni de Portmany)

facts.fact: The larger Cala Salada beach has loungers, sunshades and a restaurant serving seafood, alongside fishermen's huts carved from red ochre rock.
facts.quote: there are loungers, sunshades and a restaurant serving seafood
facts.source_title: Es Nàutic (Club Nàutic Sant Antoni de Portmany)

facts.fact: Cala Salada's facilities include sunbeds, parasols, showers (turned off to save water), a restaurant, lifeguards, toilets and disabled access.
facts.quote: facilities: sunbeds, parasols, showers (turned off to save water), restaurant, lifeguards, toilets and access for the disabled

facts.fact: The road down to the beach ends at a small, shaded car park with 65 spaces, with stairs down to the sand.
facts.quote: the road meanders down a steep gradient to a small, shaded car park with 65 spaces

facts.fact: In summer, a minibus (line P7) runs every 30 minutes from 9:30 to 20:30 from Sant Antoni bus station, with a park-and-ride stop at the Can Coix sports centre.
facts.quote: there is a minibus service (p7) every 30 minutes from 9:30 to 20:30 from san antonio bus station, with a 'park and ride' stop at the can coix sports centre

facts.fact: Neighbouring Cala Saladeta, reached by a rocky path, gets very busy in summer, especially on weekends, and has no facilities of its own.
facts.quote: this small beach gets very busy in summer, especially on weekends

facts.fact: The only beach restaurant, at a corner of Cala Salada, is popular with locals for traditional dishes like seafood paella.
facts.quote: it is popular with the locals for traditional dishes like seafood paella

facts.fact: A 2017 review notes both beaches have seasonal lifeguards, while Cala Salada alone has toilets, a wooden walkway to the sand, and a 'reasonably priced' restaurant.
facts.quote: although both beaches have their own lifeguards in season cala salada is the one with the rest of the amenities; toilets, wooden walkway onto the beach and reasonably priced cala salada restaurant

facts.fact: A newly introduced number-34 bus (as of the 2017 review) was expected to sharply increase visitor volume to the two beaches.
facts.quote: these beaches are going to be busier than ever since the number 34 bus , new this year now runs extremely regularly from san an

facts.fact: A boat return ticket (about 13 euros in 2017) was described as pricier than the bus, which cost roughly a quarter as much.
facts.quote: a €13 return ticket is a little expensive when compared to the bus at a quarter of the price

facts.fact: The ornate wrasse, a Mediterranean fish found on rocky areas with algae and Posidonia seagrass beds (habitat matching Ibiza's west coast), lives at depths of 0 to 50 metres and is IUCN Least Concern.
facts.quote: the ornate wrasse occurs in on rocky areas where there are growths of algae and posidonia sea grass beds, it is found from 0 to 50 metres (0 to 164 ft)

facts.fact: Across the EU in 2025, 85% of about 22,000 bathing-water sites were rated 'excellent' and 96% met at least minimum quality standards (general regional context, not a Cala Salada-specific rating).
facts.quote: in 2025, out of the eu's 22,000 bathing water sites, 85% were classified as excellent
facts.source_title: European Environment Agency: European bathing water quality in 2025

facts.fact: Spain accounted for 14% of all reported EU coastal bathing-water sites in 2025, one of the three largest reporting countries alongside Italy and France (country-level, not station-specific).
facts.quote: three countries accounted for over 60% of all reported coastal bathing waters: italy (33%), france and spain (14% each)
facts.source_title: European Environment Agency: European bathing water quality in 2025

facts.fact: Of 57 EU bathing waters rated 'poor' for five consecutive years (2020-2024), three were in Spain (country-level figure, not tied to a named Ibiza site).
facts.quote: three in spain, two in sweden and one each in estonia and portugal
facts.source_title: European Environment Agency: European bathing water quality in 2025

facts.fact: The Spain Film Commission's location listing places Cala Salada 4 kilometres from Sant Antoni de Portmany, sharing one u-shaped inlet with Cala Saladeta.
facts.quote: cala salada is situated at four kilometres from sant antoni de portmany

facts.fact: The coast at Cala Salada retains some 'escars,' traditional dry docks for small fishing boats, alongside its pine-tree surroundings.
facts.quote: there are some escars (typical dry docks) on the coast

facts.fact: White Ibiza's 2026 guide says Cala Salada gets busy from lunchtime onward in peak July-August but is relatively uncrowded the rest of the season.
facts.quote: cala salada can get pretty busy from about lunchtime onwards in the peak months of july and august, but for the rest of the season it's relatively un-crowded and peaceful at all hours

facts.fact: White Ibiza frames Cala Salada as a rustic beach at the foot of a pine forest that has stayed relatively unscathed by the overdevelopment seen in neighbouring areas.
facts.quote: at the foot of a pine forest, cala salada is one of the most beautiful and rustic beaches in ibiza that seems to have been relatively unscathed by the overdevelopment of its neighbouring areas

facts.fact: Barceló's visitor FAQ claims there is no public transport serving Cala Salada, recommending a taxi from Sant Antoni instead.
facts.quote: there is no public transport that leads to cala salada

facts.fact: By car, Cala Salada is about 20 kilometres (roughly 25 minutes) from Ibiza Town via the C-731 and PM-812 roads.
facts.quote: from the island capital, ibiza, there are about 20 kilometers, which can be done in about 25 minutes on the c-731 and pm-812 roads

facts.fact: The on-site restaurant is described as a family-run business without pretense, serving an Ibizan-style menu including rice dishes, lobster stew, and grilled fish and meat.
facts.quote: a family-run business, without pretenses or unnecessary gimmicks, where you can enjoy some of the best dishes featuring food typical of ibiza

recency.newest_item: Newest dated item overall is the EEA briefing (published 16 Jun 2026), reporting 85% of EU bathing sites rated excellent in 2025 — but it is EU/Spain-wide context, not a Cala Salada-specific station rating. The newest Cala Salada-specific item is 30 Apr 2026 press coverage of Sant Antoni activating the vehicle-access-control season (1 May-15 Oct 2026, 9:30-17:00 daily) under the ~113,176 euro/year contract.

dead_ends: Named restaurant's actual business name, menu items, or prices beyond the generic 'Restaurant Cala Salada' — both dedicated pages (visit.santantoni.net gastronomy listing, TripAdvisor restaurant page) returned HTTP 403 and could not be harvested.
Road distance or drive time to Ibiza airport.
Exact lifeguard staffing numbers or the precise start/end dates of the lifeguard season (sources confirm lifeguards operate in season but give no headcount or calendar).
A primary historical source for Casa Rosada's construction date or original purpose — only secondary tourism mentions were found, no archival or municipal history source.

Station-specific EU bathing-water quality classification for Cala Salada (monitoring point ES531M0461202) — the discomap.eea.europa.eu map page returned only an unrendered JavaScript placeholder ('document.write(text)'), no actual data.

An explicit on-page statement tying Posidonia-meadow anchoring restrictions specifically to Cala Salada — esnautic.com lists 'Posidonia Oceánica' only as a nav-menu category, with no sentence connecting it to this beach.
Current (2026-season) parking, bus, or boat ticket prices — only 2016-17-era fares were harvested (tourinews, santantoni.net); no updated price list found.
Visitor ratings or review excerpts for the beach or its restaurant — both TripAdvisor pages (attraction and restaurant) returned HTTP 403.
The official Sant Antoni tourism board's own beach and restaurant description pages (visit.santantoni.net) — both returned HTTP 403, so the municipal DMO's own copy is unavailable.

derivations.fact: F14 is dated 2026-04 and says the path was built 'hace dos años' (two years ago) -> 2026 - 2 = 2024 (pedestrian path built 2024).

conflicts: Beach dimensions: Wikidata/Wikipedia give Cala Salada as 75 m long by 20 m wide (F03); Ibiza Spotlight gives 200 m long (total) by 5-30 m wide (F04); Barceló gives 200 m long by ~25 m wide for Cala Salada alone (F05) — the 200 m figures may describe the combined Salada/Saladeta bay rather than Cala Salada alone.
Distance from Sant Antoni de Portmany: Wikipedia says 2.9 mi/4.7 km north (F02); Spain Film Commission says 4 km (F33).

Existence of public transport: Barceló's FAQ states there is no public transport to Cala Salada (F37), directly contradicted by the Sant Antoni council's own 'Playa Conectada' program and Ibiza Spotlight, both describing a scheduled P7 bus and boat shuttle running every summer since 2016 (F07, F08, F23).
